brief: Identify an unused recurring charge from a fictional account history.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Charges without use"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Cobros sin uso"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Cobranças sem uso"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify an unused recurring charge from a fictional account history.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A recurring charge can continue after you stop using the service.
instruction.misconception: Assuming that not using a service automatically stops its recurring charge.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: An unused music service still charges monthly. Check its renewal and cancellation terms.
Repeated charges and absent use identify a service to review.
Removing an app and ending its subscription are separate actions.
A recurring charge can support a real ongoing need.
An unknown name does not establish use or authorization.
Check the stated process; unused does not mean automatically canceled.
A shared service requires checking shared use before a decision.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
